name: HYDRA-UMC-VISION-STREAMER
notes: Functional v0: real per-camera config validation, GStreamer pipeline description generation, and MediaMTX paths.yml generation, exposed via 'config validate'/'config gst'/'config mediamtx'. 24 tests. Actually running the generated pipeline against physical USB cameras needs the V4L2/GStreamer/Hailo-8 runtime, which is future work.
